repo_notes.content: BHS refers to the codex, BHSA to the Text-Fabric dataset, and BHSaddons to the additional features supplied by this repository for BHSA version 2021. Ground all claims in repository files. Distinguish stored metadata from independently verified facts; flag conflicting documentation rather than silently resolving it. Do not invent a conversion pipeline or notebook that is not present.

pages.title: BHSaddons Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to BHSaddons: what it is, what problem it solves, how it fits into the BHSA/Text-Fabric ecosystem, and how to navigate the wiki for deeper details.

page_notes.content: Sources: README.md, tf/2021/*.tf, docs/index.html. Explain the BHS/BHSA/BHSaddons naming distinction and the seven additional features.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Step-by-step guide for installing Text-Fabric with GitHub support, loading BHSaddons as a module via the `mod` parameter, handling GitHub API rate limits, and running the first query. Covers the `use()` call pattern and common setup errors.

page_notes.content: Sources: README.md and docs/usage.html. Include from tf.app import use, version="2021", and mod="tonyjurg/BHSaddons/tf/". Separate notebook shell commands from Python code.

pages.title: License and Citation
pages.purpose: Documents licence declarations and citation: the CC BY 4.0 declaration in LICENCE.md, the CC BY-NC 4.0 declarations in feature headers and for the BHSA base data, and the unresolved discrepancy. Explains attribution and CITATION.cff, using citation DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14051604.

page_notes.content: Sources: LICENCE.md, CITATION.cff, README.md, and @license/@licenseUrl in tf/2021/*.tf. LICENCE.md declares CC BY 4.0 and identifies the BHSA base data as CC BY-NC 4.0; the feature headers themselves declare CC BY-NC 4.0. Explicitly flag this discrepancy without selecting a controlling licence. Use citation DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14051604 from CITATION.cff; the README badge links to 10.5281/zenodo.14051603. Do not assume their relationship without verification.

pages.title: Feature Reference
pages.purpose: Overview of all seven features provided by BHSaddons, their node types, data types, and the liturgical/structural concepts they encode. Links to child pages for per-feature detail.

page_notes.content: Sources: README.md, docs/features/*.md, and tf/2021/*.tf. Use @valueType for stored feature types and flag disagreements with Markdown. Six features target verse nodes; wordboundary targets word nodes.

pages.title: Parasha Features (parashanum, parashahebr, parashatrans)
pages.purpose: Detailed documentation of the three inter-related parasha identification features: the integer sequence number (`parashanum` 1–54), the Hebrew name as stored in the feature (`parashahebr`), and the Latin-script transliteration (`parashatrans`). Covers the full 54-parasha mapping table, frequency distribution of verses per parasha, and how to use these features together in TF search queries.

page_notes.content: Sources: docs/features/parashanum.md, docs/features/parashahebr.md, docs/features/parashatrans.md, and their matching tf/2021/*.tf files. Reproduce Hebrew names as stored; do not claim complete vocalization. Attribute frequency tables to the documentation unless recomputed.

pages.title: Aliyot and Maftir Features (aliyotnum, parashaverse, maftir)
pages.purpose: Documents the intra-parasha features: aliyotnum (integer aliya number, 1–7), parashaverse (integer verse position within a parasha), and maftir (string 1 or empty for maftir membership). Covers documented frequency tables, missing-value semantics, example queries, and disagreements between Markdown descriptions and .tf type metadata.

page_notes.content: Sources: docs/features/aliyotnum.md, docs/features/parashaverse.md, docs/features/maftir.md, and matching tf/2021/*.tf files. aliyotnum and parashaverse have @valueType=int although their Markdown describes strings. maftir has @valueType=str and uses string 1 or an absent value; do not describe it as a stored Boolean or integer. Preserve each feature's distinct missing-value semantics.

pages.title: Word Boundary Feature (wordboundary)
pages.purpose: Detailed documentation of the `wordboundary` feature, which operates at the `word` node level (unlike all other features which target `verse` nodes). Explains the BHSA morphemic decomposition model, how the trailing-edge '1' indicator marks the end of a surface-level typographic word, the role of the maqaf, and the Genesis 1:1 worked example.

page_notes.content: Sources: docs/features/wordboundary.md, docs/features/images/wordboundary.png, and tf/2021/wordboundary.tf. Use the Genesis 1:1 example to explain surface word boundaries versus BHSA word nodes and describe maqaf handling according to the source.

pages.title: Data Files and Internal Format
pages.purpose: Overview of the Text-Fabric .tf files, the tf/2021/ directory layout, and available metadata. Links to child pages on file format, recorded provenance, and versioning. Identifies the absence of a conversion pipeline implementation.

page_notes.content: Sources: tf/2021/*.tf and README.md. Explain available files and metadata; no conversion notebook or pipeline implementation is included in this repository.

pages.title: Text-Fabric Feature File Format
pages.purpose: Explains the `.tf` file structure: the metadata header fields (`@node`, `@valueType`, `@description`, `@coreData`, `@writtenBy`, etc.), the compact sequential node-value encoding, how implicit node-index incrementing works, and how boundary transitions (e.g., parasha resets) are encoded. Covers all seven `.tf` files in `tf/2021/`.

page_notes.content: Sources: all seven tf/2021/*.tf files, especially metadata and initial data rows. Distinguish explicit node indices, implicit increments, stored values, and missing values. Do not infer text references from numeric node IDs alone.

pages.title: Data Provenance and Versioning
pages.purpose: Documents recorded provenance metadata and the distinction between BHSaddons version 0.1 and BHSA dataset version 2021. Explains the Jupyter Notebook (TBA) provenance placeholder and the absence of the conversion notebook. Distinguishes observed node indices from text references that require verification against BHSA.

page_notes.content: Sources: @author, @convertedBy, @coreData, @coreDataUrl, @provenance, @version, and @dateWritten in tf/2021/*.tf; README.md and CITATION.cff. The headers record Public Domain, hebcal and Tony Jurg, and @provenance=Jupyter Notebook (TBA). No conversion notebook is included. Node 1414389 is visible as a starting index in verse feature data, but confirming its text reference requires the matching BHSA dataset.

pages.title: Documentation Website
pages.purpose: Explains the documentation site under docs/, its feature Markdown sources and generated HTML, local assets, and the dependency-free Python build script. Covers rebuilding, local preview, and GitHub Pages publication from main /docs.

page_notes.content: Sources: scripts/build_site.py, docs/index.html, docs/features.html, docs/features/*.md, docs/features/*.html, and docs/assets/. Run python scripts/build_site.py to rebuild, then python -m http.server 8767 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory docs to preview. Commit rebuilt HTML with source changes. Pages uses Deploy from a branch, main, /docs. Feature pages link to the original Markdown sources. Assets now live in docs/assets/; website/ was removed. Do not imply that the old GitHub Actions workflow is still active.
